# Capture cases: <name> <key> <origin> [<answer>...]
# The template at <key> (scripts/emacs-parity/capture.el in Emacs terms,
# tests/spec/emacs_capture_parity_spec.lua in org.nvim's) captures from
# <origin> into a copy of these files, and the capture is finished as
# C-c C-c does; the output is the template's file afterwards. <origin>:
#   -                 a buffer visiting no file
#   <file>:<l>        that file (an Org file or notes.txt), the cursor at the
#                     start of line <l> (%a)
#   <file>:<l1>-<l2>  the same, lines l1 to l2 selected (the region: %i)
#   string:<text>     org-capture-string / capture_string with <text> as
#                     %i ("_" for a space)
# The prompts get the <answer>s in turn ("_" for a space, "~" for an empty
# answer, which takes the default). "Now" is 2026-10-01 Thu 12:00.

# Targets and placement
entry-file          e   -
entry-prepend       ep  -
entry-no-stars      x   -
headline            h   -
headline-prepend    hp  -
headline-new        hn  -
headline-case       hc  -
headline-relevel    hd  -
olp                 o   -
regexp              r   -
datetree            d   -
datetree-week       dw  -
datetree-month      dm  -
datetree-olp        do  -
datetree-day        dd  -
datetree-quarter    dq  -
no-newline          nl  -
no-newline-plain    np  -
immediate           if  -

# Types
item                i   -
item-prepend        ip  -
item-ordered        in  -
item-no-list        iw  -
item-initial        ii  source.org:2-3
checkitem           c   -
checkitem-ordered   co  -
checkitem-default   ce  -
table-line          t   -
table-line-pos      tp  -
table-line-prepend  tP  -
table-line-new      tn  -
plain               p   -
plain-prepend       pp  -
plain-file          pf  -

# Empty lines
empty-lines         el  -
empty-lines-before  eb  -
empty-lines-after   ea  -
item-empty-lines    il  -

# Escapes
dates               T   -
literal             L   -
text-after-cursor   m   -
planning            s   -
link-heading        a   source.org:1
link-todo-heading   a   source.org:4
link-text-file      a   notes.txt:2
origin-file         f   source.org:1
initial-string      I   string:hello_world
initial-region      Ir  source.org:2-3
prompts             P   -   My_title ~
tags                g   -   work:urgent
property            pr  -   1:00
